Referral for cardiology assessment: Mr Jonas Becker, born 3 July 1961

Thank you for seeing Mr Becker, a retired bus driver aged 65, who has had episodes of exertional chest tightness for the past eight weeks. I would be grateful for your assessment of a possible angina and for advice on further investigations.
The episodes come on after about ten minutes of brisk walking and settle within five minutes of rest. He has had no episodes at rest and no syncope, and there is no history of palpitations.
Hypertension, diagnosed in 2018 and well controlled on treatment.
Ex-smoker; stopped in 2015 after thirty pack years.
Father had a myocardial infarction at the age of 58.

On examination there was no evidence of heart failure and the chest was clear. I have asked Mr Becker to avoid strenuous exertion until he has been seen and to use his glyceryl trinitrate spray if symptoms come on.
